classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

contentEditable.description: If true, the whole element is editable. Useful when all the sections are selected.

elements.description: The elements to render. Each element contains the prop to edit a section of the value.

sectionListRef.description: The ref used to access the DOM elements of the sections.

slotProps.description: The props used for each component slot.

slotDescriptions.root: The component that renders the root.
slotDescriptions.section: The component that renders a section.
slotDescriptions.sectionContent: The component that renders the editable content of a section.
slotDescriptions.sectionSeparator: The component that renders the separator before or after a section.
